record_type_quote: Our aim was, the replication in the Spanish population of the association described in the Turkish population between ERAP1 (rs17482078) and BD.

targets.authors: Kirino, Y., Bertsias, G., Ishigatsubo, Y., Mizuki, N., Tugal-Tutkun, I., et al.
targets.title: Genome-wide association analysis identifies new susceptibility loci for Behçet's disease and epistasis between HLA-B*51 and ERAP1.
targets.evidence_quote: In their study, Kirino et al [12], described a recessive model of association with BD in a Turkish population and they found an epistatic interaction between HLA-B51 and ERAP1 which could not be replicated in a Japanese cohort [12]. The objective of the present study was to asses the association of ERAP1 with BD in the Spanish population.
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, data in the Spanish population were consistent with association between ERAP1 and BD as well as with an epistatic interaction between ERAP1 and HLA-B described in the Turkish population, although our results were not statistically significant.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The overall conclusion explicitly judges the results consistent with both prior findings. Under the codebook, this authors’ agreement verdict takes priority over absence of statistical significance. The original association and corresponding new effects are both stated.

reasoning: Independent Spanish case-control cohort re-tests Kirino et al. 2013 Turkish association and interaction findings.
